hotels.title: Five-Star Turkey Kempinski Oceanfront Glamour on the Med with Two Championship 18-Hole Golf Courses
hotels.description: Signature five-star luxury is just the start at the opulent Kempinski Hotel The Dome Belek, a shining gem along Turkey's Mediterranean coastline. Sitting on the shores of Kadriye Beach in Antalya, this architectural delight is a feast for the senses with a vast 2,123sqm outdoor swimming pool and eight restaurants and bars. Savour freshly prepared pastries at the Kempinski Patisserie, start your day with a breakfast fit for royalty at Lale Restaurant and indulge in the finest regional Italian dishes at Cilantro Restaurant. Keen golfers will delight in the two world-class 18-hole courses - The PGA Sultan and The Pasha, designed by leading architects of European Golf Design.
